In the Property Editor, click on the Select Grading icon to set the number of garments. Then, let's change the grain direction below to 2-way or 4-way. The One Bundle One Direction option, which was not activated below, is activated. Now, click on the checkbox in this option and set it to On. Click on the Nest All Patterns icon to start nesting. In the Toggle menu, in the Garment Display, activate the Show Grading Random Color option and in the Information Display, activate the Show Grain Line option. Let's take a look at the results. The overall nesting is nesting according to the 2-way grain direction set, but the pattern pieces of the same size are all nesting in the same direction. Next, from the 2026.0 version, it is now possible to nesting efficiently by selecting the desired baseline from the Print Layout mode, Sim Allowance, and Baseline. In the Print Layout Editor toolbar, click on Nest Settings. Under the Nesting menu in the Property Editor, you can see the newly added Preferred Outline menu. In the Dropdown menu, you can select the desired baseline by using the Dropdown menu. Let's compare the results of nesting by applying three options in turn, Pattern Outline, Sim Allowance, and Baseline. First, select the Preferred Outline as Pattern Outline. Then, click on the Nest All Patterns icon. Nesting is done only based on the outline of the pattern except for the point. Next, select the Sim Allowance option, and click on the Nest All Patterns icon again. This time, you can see that the pattern is nesting, including the amount of the specified baseline. If the baseline of the pattern is created in CLO, Sim Allowance is automatically applied to the default value and can be nesting easily. Lastly, select the Sim Allowance option and click on the Nest All Patterns icon. Next, select the Sim Allowance option and click on the Nest All Patterns icon. Finally, select the Sim Allowance option and click on the Nest All Patterns icon. Let's check the baseline option using another file. When the external CAD pattern is brought to DXF, the C-fold is expressed as the baseline. At this time, if you set the Preferred Outline as the baseline, you can nest the C-fold expressed as the baseline. In the same way, move to Print Layout mode, select the Preferred Outline option and change it to the baseline. When you click on the Nest All Patterns icon, you can see that the pattern is nesting based on the baseline of the pattern. Next, the Tape Measure tool, which measures the distance between the two points you want in the Print Layout Editor, is updated to measure the size of the fabric pattern, and you can quickly check the distance between the patterns. In the Print Layout Editor toolbar, click on the Tape Measure Point to Point icon. Then, click on the edge or other specific point of the pattern you want to check the distance. Then, as you can see, the exact measurement distance between the two points is displayed. The measurement value is displayed only one at a time, and if you click on another point again, the previous measurement value will be automatically deleted and a new measurement will start. If you want to remove the Tape Measure tool selection, click on the icon one more time or press the ESC button on the keyboard. Next, previously, when rotating the pattern in the Print Layout, you had to select the rotation angle one by one through the right-click menu, but from this version, it is possible to quickly work only with the mode control. After right-clicking on the pattern, you can see that there is a shortcut key designated by the rotation direction and angle when you raise the mouse on the Rotate menu in the pop-up menu. Please select one or several patterns that require rotation. Press the CTRL key, then press the arrow key on the right, and rotate 45 degrees clockwise, and press the arrow key on the left, and rotate 45 degrees counterclockwise. If you want to rotate in a larger angle, press the arrow key on the top, and rotate counterclockwise 90 degrees, and press the arrow key on the bottom, and rotate counterclockwise 90 degrees. I hope you can increase the efficiency of the production process through the faster and easier Print Layout function. In this latest version, in order to support the efficiency and precision of the collaboration workflow, a new marker function has been added to the animation editor. Timing is the most important element in animation projects. If you use this marker function, you can leave a note on the timeline like a digital post-it, and you can clearly record and manage the correction or intention of the correction at the time of creation. Then, let's take a closer look at how to use it through the example file. To look at the function, first, let's move to the animation editor at the bottom of the screen. Please check the timeline ruler section with the frame number in the middle. If you want to leave a note at a certain point of the costume, bag, or soft body animation, right-click on the timeline ruler. In the context menu, click on the additional menu at the bottom of the marker group. At the same time, a marker setting window appears. Here, like Start Here, you can specify the name of the marker and set the exact frame number to place the marker. After setting up and clicking OK, you can see that a marker indicator has been created on the timeline. And if you hover the mouse over the created marker, the name and frame location you set appear in pop-up and you can quickly check the contents. If you want to modify the created marker, you can select edit after right-clicking the mouse on the marker, or you can double-click the marker to reopen the settings window. Also, if you drag left and right while clicking the marker icon, you can freely adjust the frame position of the marker according to the flow of the animation. It is also very easy to copy or delete the marker. You can right-click on the marker to select the desired movement, or you can copy the marker using Ctrl-C and Ctrl-V, which are the shortcut keys for faster work. You can delete the unnecessary marker by pressing the Delete key after selecting it. So far, we have learned about the newly updated animation marker function. Through this function, you can manage the communication notes between team members more systematically and efficiently organize the creative production process. Next is the improvement related to rendering. Previously, when applying a fur material to an outfit, the fur did not cover the seam line and the detail of the sewing line was not properly expressed. There was a disappointment. From the 2026.0 version, it is possible to carefully trim the fur based on the sewing line. Not only the clothes that use fur material, but also dolls and home-tech style products can be implemented more realistically. Let's take a closer look at the example. First, prepare an outfit with the material type of the fabric set to Fur Strand or Fur Render Only. In this video, I will use an outfit that set the material type to Fur Strand to immediately check the fur trimmer application results in the 3D window. Select Edit Sewing Tool from the toolbar and click the sewing line to apply the fur trimming effect. If you look at the property editor, you can see that the fur trimmer option has been newly added under the 3D SIM 9 menu. First, you can check the thickness of the fur and adjust the thickness value to determine the width of the fur. This value can be entered from 0 to up to 10cm. The larger the value, the wider the area where the fur is trimmed. Here, let's change the value to 2cm and check the change. Next, let's adjust the gradation value. This value determines the point where the length of the fur begins to change in the thickness area set, and how smoothly the border will be processed. The higher the value, the softer the boundary, the more naturally it is processed, and the lower the value, the clearer the division of the area where the fur is trimmed. If you want to see more realistic final results, check the results in the Render window. I hope you can implement various fur designs through the newly added fur trimmer function. In the past, you would have used Schematic Render to create a urbanized image, and then you would have had to go through a lot of trouble because you had to input the fur information separately. From the 206.0 version, you can directly display the POM, that is, the fur per area, in the Schematic Render, so that you can create a urbanized image that is faster and more accurate with the fur information included. Let's take a closer look at the preview of the POM information. First, click on the POM tab in the object browser at the top right to check the currently registered POM list. Once the list is checked, click on the Schematic Render icon in the menu in the 3D window. If you look at the Schematic Render window options, you can see that the 2D measurement menu has been added. You can set the entire number of figures with the eye icon on the right of the menu. You can also freely change the color and thickness of the line according to your needs. If you want to display only a certain number of figures, you can activate the eye icon next to each item in the POM tab list individually and set it. Everyone, from now on, the newly improved Exclude Ground Shadow from Reflection from the CLO 2026.0 version will also be available. In the previous version, when rendering a material with high reflectivity such as metal or glass, when activating the Ground Shadow option, not only the shadow on the ground, but also the environmental map information projected on the shadow were reflected on the surface of the object. As a result, unintentional impressions were expressed and the quality of the results were reduced. From this 2026.0 version, while maintaining the shadow on the ground, a new option has been added that allows you to exclude shadow information only on the reflection of the object. Through this, you can get a cleaner and more realistic rendering result. Let's take a closer look at the example. Let's take a closer look at the example file on the screen. Currently, this avatar has a metallic coating applied to the glass material, reflecting light like a mirror, and the jacket trim is also set to be metallic, resulting in a strong reflection. To check the function, click on the Render button in the top-main menu to open the Render window. In the Render toolbar on the right of the Render window, click on the Light Property icon. In the property editor at the bottom, let's look for the Ground Shadow option and activate it. As you can see, a shadow appears on the ground. However, since this shadow contains environmental map information, you can see the reflection of the dark environment map on the ground reflected on the surface of the avatar and the metal trim of the jacket. Now, let's apply the new option in this version. If you look at the bottom of the Ground Shadow item, you can see the option to exclude from reflection, and if you click on the Render button, you can see a new checkbox called Render. Click on this checkbox to activate it, and click on the Interactive Render button at the top to check the changes in real-time. As you can see, the shadow on the ground is maintained naturally, but only the dirty environment and map reflection information have been removed. So far, we have learned about the new function of the CLO 2026 light, Exclude Ground Shadow from Reflection. By using this function, you can minimize unnecessary shadow interference when rendering outfits that contain reflective materials and create a more clear and high-quality image. Lastly, this is an improvement related to Closet. Let's take a closer look. Hello, everyone. The new function I'm going to introduce is the content page and the workroom interface that have been newly updated in Closet. In order to provide a more optimized work environment and improved experience for Closet users, we have greatly upgraded the overall layout and functions. Let's take a closer look at how they have changed. First of all, let's check the overview section. If you upload a 3D file to Closet, you will see this overview page first. Also, through the input field located at the bottom, you can directly enter and manage the main information such as the category of the outfit. If you click the setting button at the top right, you can customize the content items that will be displayed on the first page in Closet. In addition, by clicking on the sub-tabs at the top, you can easily access detailed information such as details, versions, and related content. Next is the viewer section. A variety of changes have been applied to the 3D viewer to make the work more convenient. First, if you click the first option on the 3D live viewer, you can now use the Closet quality render function to create a more realistic high-quality preview. And let's click the tabs located at the top right. Here, you can intuitively check and control each annotation and colorway information. If you click the sidebar located on the left, you can easily manage the version. Next is the BOM section. In this tab, you can see the BOM data that was created according to the standards set in the Closet 3D software. If you right-click each section of the BOM sheet, you can modify individual data directly. Also, if there is a new BOM data that was not created in the previously uploaded Closet 3D, you can import it right away, which is very convenient. Next to the BOM tab, there is a POM section. As in the previous BOM, you can call the POM data set in the Closet 3D and show the detailed measurement items. Next, in the Attachment section, you can freely upload and store the BOM data files. Finally, in the Content Analysis tab, you can analyze the total lead time and progress situation required to create a certain style. In addition, the main functions for collaboration are included in the new content page. If you click the button at the top right, you can share the contents of the content with the user. Next to the comments, you can see all the changes that occurred in the file through the Activity Log. You can also change the display mode. If you click the user icon at the top right of the screen, you can change the theme to dark mode so that you can reduce eye fatigue when working for a long time. If you click the button at the thumbnail corner of each file, you can quickly check the key information of the file without opening the file directly. In this way, we have learned about the new content page and the workroom interface of the greatly improved Closet. By actively utilizing the newly introduced functions and intuitive UI, you will be able to experience a lot more in the future. With this, I would like to end the webinar on Closet 206.0 Thank you so much for being with us for a long time. Today's session will be uploaded right after the end of the session. In particular, we have set up a timeline for each function at the bottom of the video, so we will see you in the next version with a more advanced version. Thank you.
markdown_content: # CLO 2026.0 Webinar: New Features & Workflow Improvements (한국어) 이 문서는 **CLO 2026.0** 웹비나에서 소개된 신규 기능과 개선 사항을 **검색/임베딩 친화적으로** 정리한 지식 문서입니다. 주요 주제는 **2D/3D 작업 효율**, **패턴/POM/그레이딩 워크플로**, **스트레인/프레셔 맵**, **레이싱 도구(레이스/끈)**, **글루(본딩) 도구**, **텍스처/렌더링**, **애니메이션 마커**, **Closet UI 개선**, **아바타/소재/니트 스와치 편집** 등입니다. --- ## 1) 2026.0 핵심 기능 6가지: CLO 3D Pen(3D 펜) 기반 아바타 드로잉 이 섹션은 **아바타 표면에 직접 그리는 3D 펜(3D Pencil)** 기능의 핵심 흐름과 옵션(대칭/가이드/지우개/스트레이트 입력) 및 변환 과정을 다룹니다. ### 1.1 2D 스케치 → 3D 펜 곡선 변환 워크플로 - 아바타에 **선(라인)을 자유롭게 그린 뒤**, 이를 **곡선(curve)** 형태의 패턴으로 생성하는 **3D pen 기능**이 추가되었습니다. - 작업 흐름: 1. 상단에 **Sketch window(스케치 창)**, 2D 창과 함께 **3D 창**이 표시됨 2. 3D 창은 스케치 작업에 맞춰 **최적화된 정면 뷰(front view)** 로 자동 변환 3. **정면/후면 시점 고정**, 회전 제한으로 정확한 드로잉 지원 4. 정면/후면은 **확대/축소**만 가능 ### 1.2 Pencil 스케치 입력과 실시간 스무스 커브 - Sketch window 타입을 **Pencil**로 설정 후, 아바타 상단에서 **클릭 & 드래그**로 라인 드로잉 - 드로잉 중 **smooth ring**이 실시간 적용되어 **매우 매끄러운 곡선** 생성 ### 1.3 Symmetry(대칭) 옵션과 변환 가이드 - **Symmetry 옵션 ON** 시, 아바타 중심축 기준으로 **좌/우 대칭 스케치가 동시에 수행** - 재킷/드레스의 좌우 대칭 맞추기에 유용 - **Conversion guide**(변환 가이드) 제공: - 스케치 라인이 3D 펜으로 변환될 때 **점(dots)이 굽는 지점**을 표시 - 곡률이 너무 둥글면 가이드를 통해 점 위치 확인 가능 - 뷰포트 하단 버튼으로 **점의 위치를 변경**하여 전/후면 벤딩 및 전체 실루엣 완성 ### 1.4 지우개(Eraser), Shift 직선 입력 - Sketch 창 상단의 **Eraser 아이콘** 사용 - 하단 **size slider**로 지우개 크기 설정: **10~100 pixels** - 화면의 **이중 테두리 영역**에서 원형 커서로 드래그 시 해당 라인이 깔끔하게 삭제 - 키보드 **Shift를 누른 상태로 드래그**하면 **직선 라인** 생성 가능 ### 1.5 Convert to 3D Pen / Edit 3D Pen Avatadon - Sketch 창에서 **Convert to 3D Pen**: - **Edit 3D Pen** 버튼 클릭 시, 2D 스케치가 아바타 표면에 **3D 펜 곡선**으로 즉시 변환 - 동시에 도구가 **Edit 3D Pen Avatadon**으로 전환되어 **즉시 수정** 가능 - 전/후면이 연결된 스케치라면: - 두 라인이 결합되어 **3D shape** 생성 - 라인을 선택 후: - **Select & tool**로 열면, 재봉(sewing)까지 완료된 패턴이 빠르게 생성됨 --- ## 2) POM 자동 생성 및 수정 + 패턴 Drafter/그레이딩(Grading) 확장(2D) 이 섹션은 **Pattern Drafter**를 통한 **POM 자동 생성**, **편집 모드(Edit)**에서의 **측정값 반영/업데이트**, 그리고 **그레이딩 테이블(Add Grading)** 생성/수정 과정을 다룹니다. ### 2.1 Pattern Drafter 실행: POM 자동 생성 조건 - 상단 메인 메뉴에서: - **2D → Pattern Drafter** 실행 - 예: **T-shirt setting** 카테고리 선택 - Pattern Drafter에서 POM 생성은 **현재 창에서 활성화된 measurement items** 기반으로 이루어짐 - 원하는 POM 측정 항목은 **측정 목록에서 먼저 활성화**해야 함 ### 2.2 POM 값 직접 수정과 실시간 연동 - 2D 패턴 창에서 생성된 POM 확인: - Object Browser의 **POM 탭**에서 생성된 POM 확인 - 2D 툴바에서 **추가된 POM tool** 선택 후, 2D 패턴 창에서 **POM 라인을 클릭**하여 수치 직접 수정 - 값 변경 시: - Pattern Drafter 창 입력값과 - Object Browser의 POM 탭 데이터가 **실시간으로 함께 업데이트/연동** ### 2.3 파라메트릭 편집 주의: Edit Pattern 드래그 변경 - **Edit Pattern tool**로 윤곽을 직접 드래그 변경하면, - Pattern Drafter가 **파라메트릭 값으로 다시 수정하기 어려워질 수 있음** - 대응: - Pattern Drafter의 **Edit in Drafter**로 들어가면 측정값 수정 계속 가능 - **Proceed** 시에는 Drafter 측정 기반 연결을 끊고 일반 패턴처럼 직접 수정 가능 - **Cancel**로 현재 상태 유지 후 가이드 창 닫기 ### 2.4 Pattern Drafter Edit Mode: Ghost 패턴과 Update/Create as New - Pattern Drafter 창에서 **Create/Edit 버튼** 제공 - Edit 아이콘 클릭: - 2D 패턴 창에 있는 선택된 패턴에 대해 **활성화된 measurement list가 표시** - 2D 창의 패턴이 **ghost pattern**으로 변경됨 - Edit POM tool로 변경된 **Neck Width** 등 값 확인 - 측정 항목 추가도 가능: - 예: Front Body 항목 기준으로 **Back Body 항목 활성화** 후 값 변경 - 하단 우측 버튼: - **Update**: 현재 선택 패턴에 변경사항 즉시 반영 - **Create as New**: 기존 패턴 유지 후, 업데이트된 데이터로 **새 패턴 생성** ### 2.5 여러 패턴(Edit Mode) 개별 수정/업데이트 - Edit Mode 창 우측 상단에 **패턴 선택용 드롭다운** 추가 - 드롭다운에서 특정 패턴 선택 시: - 2D 창에 해당 패턴만 ghost로 표시 - 패턴별로 **개별 수정/업데이트** 가능 ### 2.6 그레이딩 생성/수정: Add Grading → Size Table - Pattern Drafter 우측 상단의 **Add Grading** 아이콘 - Size Table 팝업: - **plus 버튼**으로 사이즈를 원하는 만큼 추가 - 각 사이즈 아이템 더블클릭으로 이름 변경 가능 - 특정 사이즈 선택 후 plus: - 선택한 사이즈 위에 새 사이즈 추가 - **중간 사이즈 기준으로 그레이딩 확장** 가능 - 그레이딩 완료 후: - 마지막 표준(base size)을 선택하고 **OK** - Pattern Drafter에서 base size가 강조 표시됨 - 좌측: base보다 작은 사이즈 확장 - 우측: base보다 큰 사이즈 확장 - 편차(deviation) 값 입력 후 **Update** - 결과 확인: - 2D 창 상단 **Show Grading** 아이콘으로 표시 - Object Browser의 **Grading 탭**에서 리스트 확인 - 수정 필요 시: - Edit mode로 돌아가 그레이딩 테이블 수치 변경 후 **Update**로 전체 패턴 동시 반영 --- ## 3) Strain Map 개선: Global/Fabric 모드, 업데이트 UI, 그래프/정보/지원 제한 이 섹션은 **Strain Map**의 개선점(시각적 현실감 향상, 즉시 조절되는 UI, Global vs Fabric 모드 차이, 그래프 유형/정보 표시, 업데이트 버튼 사용법, 지원 제한)을 다룹

chunks.content: # CLO 2026.0 Webinar: New Features & Workflow Improvements (한국어) 이 문서는 **CLO 2026.0** 웹비나에서 소개된 신규 기능과 개선 사항을 **검색/임베딩 친화적으로** 정리한 지식 문서입니다. 주요 주제는 **2D/3D 작업 효율**, **패턴/POM/그레이딩 워크플로**, **스트레인/프레셔 맵**, **레이싱 도구(레이스/끈)**, **글루(본딩) 도구**, **텍스처/렌더링**, **애니메이션 마커**, **Closet UI 개선**, **아바타/소재/니트 스와치 편집** 등입니다. --- ## 1) 2026.0 핵심 기능 6가지: CLO 3D Pen(3D 펜) 기반 아바타 드로잉 이 섹션은 **아바타 표면에 직접 그리는 3D 펜(3D Pencil)** 기능의 핵심 흐름과 옵션(대칭/가이드/지우개/스트레이트 입력) 및 변환 과정을 다룹니다. ### 1.1 2D 스케치 → 3D 펜 곡선 변환 워크플로 - 아바타에 **선(라인)을 자유롭게 그린 뒤**, 이를 **곡선(curve)** 형태의 패턴으로 생성하는 **3D pen 기능**이 추가되었습니다. - 작업 흐름: 1. 상단에 **Sketch window(스케치 창)**, 2D 창과 함께 **3D 창**이 표시됨 2. 3D 창은 스케치 작업에 맞춰 **최적화된 정면 뷰(front view)** 로 자동 변환 3. **정면/후면 시점 고정**, 회전 제한으로 정확한 드로잉 지원 4. 정면/후면은 **확대/축소**만 가능 ### 1.2 Pencil 스케치 입력과 실시간 스무스 커브 - Sketch window 타입을 **Pencil**로 설정 후, 아바타 상단에서 **클릭 & 드래그**로 라인 드로잉 - 드로잉 중 **smooth ring**이 실시간 적용되어 **매우 매끄러운 곡선** 생성 ### 1.3 Symmetry(대칭) 옵션과 변환 가이드 - **Symmetry 옵션 ON** 시, 아바타 중심축 기준으로 **좌/우 대칭 스케치가 동시에 수행** - 재킷/드레스의 좌우 대칭 맞추기에 유용 - **Conversion guide**(변환 가이드) 제공: - 스케치 라인이 3D 펜으로 변환될 때 **점(dots)이 굽는 지점**을 표시 - 곡률이 너무 둥글면 가이드를 통해 점 위치 확인 가능 - 뷰포트 하단 버튼으로 **점의 위치를 변경**하여 전/후면 벤딩 및 전체 실루엣 완성 ### 1.4 지우개(Eraser), Shift 직선 입력 - Sketch 창 상단의 **Eraser 아이콘** 사용 - 하단 **size slider**로 지우개 크기 설정: **10~100 pixels** - 화면의 **이중 테두리 영역**에서 원형 커서로 드래그 시 해당 라인이 깔끔하게 삭제 - 키보드 **Shift를 누른 상태로 드래그**하면 **직선 라인** 생성 가능 ### 1.5 Convert to 3D Pen / Edit 3D Pen Avatadon - Sketch 창에서 **Convert to 3D Pen**: - **Edit 3D Pen** 버튼 클릭 시, 2D 스케치가 아바타 표면에 **3D 펜 곡선**으로 즉시 변환 - 동시에 도구가 **Edit 3D Pen Avatadon**으로 전환되어 **즉시 수정** 가능 - 전/후면이 연결된 스케치라면: - 두 라인이 결합되어 **3D shape** 생성 - 라인을 선택 후: - **Select & tool**로 열면, 재봉(sewing)까지 완료된 패턴이 빠르게 생성됨 --- ## 2) POM 자동 생성 및 수정 + 패턴 Drafter/그레이딩(Grading) 확장(2D) 이 섹션은 **Pattern Drafter**를 통한 **POM 자동 생성**, **편집 모드(Edit)**에서의 **측정값 반영/업데이트**, 그리고 **그레이딩 테이블(Add Grading)** 생성/수정 과정을 다룹니다.
